design.name: 穷奇
design.brief: Qiongqi (穷奇), one of the Four Fiends of Chinese myth, 'shaped like a tiger with wings', with the 'hedgehog-quill fur' of its Western Mountains description: a powerful winged tiger about 2.6 m long and 1.3 m at the shoulder, rusty orange-and-black tiger stripes, a big blocky head with a fierce snarl and fangs, two large feathered wings (dark brown with cream bands) spread for a gliding pounce, and a crest of stiff quill-like spines along the neck and back that crackles with magenta-violet lightning and glows (weak spot); violet glowing eyes, lightning veins along the wing bones. Apex predator. NOT a griffin: a real tiger body with wings.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
